dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 時間になったら始めようと思いますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's about time, so I'd like to begin, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日は、どの様なご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんな相談でも大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Is it alright to talk about anything?

dialogue.content: はい。どんな事でも、気になっている事があれば、話し易い所から話されてみて下さい。
dialogue.English: Yes. Whatever is on your mind, please feel free to start wherever is easiest for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: どんな事がおありですか？
dialogue.English: What's been on your mind?

dialogue.content: 最近元気が出ないんです
dialogue.English: I just haven't had any energy lately.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ご自分で、元気が出ないな、と感じていらっしゃるのですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been feeling that you don't have any energy?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 最近と言いますと・・・いつ位からそんな風に感じられていますか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned "lately"... about how long have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: ここ数年ですね
dialogue.English: For the past few years.

dialogue.content: それは、気になられますね。よろしかったら、御年齢と、性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: That must be concerning. If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 60代 女です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 60s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 数年前からという事ですが、その頃に何か気になる事があったとか、環境の変化など、ご自身で思い付く様な事はあったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You said it's been a few years. Around that time, was there anything that happened, like a change in your environment, or anything else you can think of that might be related?

dialogue.content: 去年ペットが亡くなりました
dialogue.English: My pet passed away last year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお寂しいですね。ペットと言われるのは、ネコさんですか？どんなペットさんだったのでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very lonely. When you say pet, was it a cat? What kind of pet was it?

dialogue.content: 犬です
dialogue.English: It was a dog.

dialogue.content: そうですか。犬さんなんですね。その犬さんとはどの様なご関係を築いてこられたのでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see, it was a dog. What was your relationship with your dog like?

dialogue.content: 愛犬ですね
dialogue.English: He was my beloved dog.

dialogue.content: では、本当に深い愛情を持って関わっていらっしゃったのですね。
dialogue.English: So you truly had a very deep and loving bond with him.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 元気が出ない、と思われているのは、その愛犬さんが無くなられた事が原因だとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you think that the reason you're feeling this lack of energy is because of your beloved dog's passing?

dialogue.content: それ以外にも、何か思い当たる事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Or is there anything else that comes to mind?

dialogue.content: 色々なことがあります
dialogue.English: There are many things.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。他にはどんな事が？話せる範囲で良いのですが、何かあれば
dialogue.English: I see. What other kinds of things? You only have to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 自分の周りから全てが消えていきます
dialogue.English: Everything around me is disappearing.

dialogue.content: 消える・・・それは、愛犬さんの様に、ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Disappearing… do you mean like your dog passing away?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうお感になられる様な色々な事が、ここ数年続いていて、そんな事が重なり、元気がでないと感じていらっしゃるのでしょか。如何でしょう‥
dialogue.English: So, for the past few years, various things have happened that make you feel that way, and as they've piled up, you've come to feel you have no energy. Is that how it feels?

dialogue.content: もう生きる希望も感じられないです
dialogue.English: I don't even feel any hope to go on living anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。悲しい事が続いてしまわれて、そうお感じになられても仕方のない悲しみの中にいらっしゃると感じます。今、どなたかとご一緒に生活されていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. With so many sad things happening one after another, it's understandable that you would be in a place of sorrow where you feel that way. Are you currently living with anyone?

dialogue.content: 1人です
dialogue.English: I'm alone.

dialogue.content: そうですか。そんなご自身のお気持ちを話されるお友達や、ご家族などは、いらっしゃるでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you have any friends or family you can talk to about how you're feeling?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: では、ここ数年、そんな寂しいお気持ちを一人で抱えながら過ごしてこられたんですね。それは、お辛かったですね。
dialogue.English: So for the past few years, you've been carrying these lonely feelings all by yourself. That must have been very difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: It has been.

dialogue.content: もう生きていても仕方ないのでしょうね
dialogue.English: I guess there's no point in living anymore.

dialogue.content: その様に感じられているのですね。でも、今日は、こうしてご相談に来られてありがとうございます。少しでもあなた様のお気持ちが楽になるよう、ご一緒に考えていきたいと思うのですが
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling right now. But thank you for coming to talk with me today. I'd like to think together with you to see if we can help you feel even a little bit better.

dialogue.content: 今、お仕事などはされていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently working?

dialogue.content: コロナで退職になりました
dialogue.English: I had to leave my job because of COVID.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それはショックでしたね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been a shock.

dialogue.content: この歳では次の仕事もないです
dialogue.English: At my age, there are no other jobs.

dialogue.content: その事もあって、先ほど「色んな物が消える」と言われたのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's another reason why you said earlier that "everything around me is disappearing."

dialogue.content: はい、両親も次々亡くなりました
dialogue.English: Yes, and my parents also passed away, one after the other.

dialogue.content: それは、大変な喪失感に襲われたり、元気が出ない、と言われても仕方のない状況だと思います。今、生活費の方は、どの様にされていますか？
dialogue.English: That sounds like you've been hit with a terrible sense of loss. It's completely understandable that you'd say you have no energy in this situation. How are you managing your living expenses right now?

dialogue.content: 貯金で生活していますが、いつまで持つか。。
dialogue.English: I’m living off my savings, but I’m not sure how long they’ll last…

dialogue.content: もう何もないです
dialogue.English: I feel like I have nothing left.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それはご不安ですね。少しお話をまとめさせていただきますね。ここ数年、貴方の大切な方々や、愛犬、が亡くなり、その上お仕事もコロナで退職をしなければいけなくなり
dialogue.English: Yes, that must be very worrying. Let me try to summarize what we've talked about. Over the past few years, your loved ones and your beloved dog have passed away, and on top of that, you had to leave your job because of COVID.

dialogue.content: 次のお仕事もなかなか見つからない今の状況に、生き辛さを感じていらっしゃるという事ですね？いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: And now, finding it difficult to get a new job, you're feeling that life is hard to bear. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: 生きていても仕方がないです
dialogue.English: There's no point in living.

dialogue.content: どなたか、ご相談出来る方がいらっしゃると良いのですが・・以前の職場などのお仲間などで、同じ様にコロナなどで退職されてお仕事を探されていたりする方で、お話が出来そうな方などはいらっしゃらないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It would be good if you had someone to talk to... For example, are there any former colleagues from your previous workplace who might have also left their jobs due to COVID and are looking for work, that you might be able to talk to?

dialogue.content: いないです
dialogue.English: There's no one.

dialogue.content: そうですか。今、お仕事は、どの様に探されていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. How are you looking for a job right now?

dialogue.content: 携帯で見ます
dialogue.English: I look on my phone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お仕事がみつかれば、また、心境や状況も変わると思うのですが。ハローワークなどは、行かれた事はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. I think if you were to find a job, your feelings and situation might change. Have you ever been to a Hello Work (public employment service center)?

dialogue.content: まだです
dialogue.English: Not yet.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ハローワークには、キャリアコンサルタントの方がいらして、色々とお仕事などの相談に乗ってくれます。また、生活のご相談も出来ます。何か、良い方法が見つかるのではと思いますが、一度いかれてみませんか？
dialogue.English: I see. At Hello Work, there are career consultants who can provide advice on various things like job searching. You can also get advice about your daily life. I think you might be able to find a good solution there. Would you consider going once?

dialogue.content: いかがでしょう？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね・・
dialogue.English: I suppose so…

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今のお気持ちを考えると、中々勇気のいる行動かもしれませんが
dialogue.English: Considering how you feel now, I know it might take a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 動いてみると、何か良い方法が見つかったり、新しい出会いや、道が見えてきたりすることもあるので、
dialogue.English: But if you take that step, you might find a good solution, or it could lead to new encounters and a new path opening up.

dialogue.content: 良かったら、一度、訪ねて見られては、と思います。
dialogue.English: If you feel up to it, I think it would be good to visit.

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: 今のお辛い気持ちは分かりますので、直ぐに、でなくても
dialogue.English: I understand how difficult things are for you right now, so it doesn't have to be right away.

dialogue.content: 少し、御気分の良い時にでも
dialogue.English: Perhaps when you're feeling a little better.

dialogue.content: そうですね・・・
dialogue.English: Right...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無理はなさらなくても、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: You don't have to push yourself. It's okay.

dialogue.content: はい・・
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: では行ってみます・・
dialogue.English: Then... I'll try going.

dialogue.content: 何か、少しでもお気持ちが晴れれば、と思います。今日もこうしてご相談にきてくださっています。また、ハローワークなどの相談機関で話されたりする事で、これからのこともすっこしずつ見えてくるのでは、と思います。無理はなさらず、ゆっくりと、で大丈夫なので・・・
dialogue.English: I hope it will help you feel even a little bit brighter. You took the step to come and talk with me today. And by speaking with support agencies like Hello Work, I think you'll start to see the path forward, little by little. Please don't push yourself; it's okay to take it slow.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 後、もし、何かお好きな事があれば、例えば、お好きなお茶をゆっくり飲むとか、お風呂にゆっくりつかるとか、ご自身の時間を大切に、少しでも良い時間をお過ごし頂ければと思います。
dialogue.English: Also, if there's anything you enjoy, for example, slowly sipping a cup of tea you like, or taking a long, relaxing bath, I hope you can cherish your own time and spend it in a way that feels even a little bit good.

dialogue.content: そうします・・
dialogue.English: I'll do that...

dialogue.content: ええ。少しずつ、で大丈夫ですので、良かったら。もう少しで、相談終了のお時間となりますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes. Little by little is perfectly fine. Our session time is almost up, is that all right?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談に来て頂いて、ありがとうございました。また、何かありましたら、いつでもいらして下さいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in to talk today. If anything comes up, please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、これで終了させて頂きます。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Then, we'll end our session here. Take care.
